Does Brad Pitt die in True Romance?

He plays Floyd, a cameo role.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows the answer, the scene, and a clip if we have one.

No. Never leaves the couch or the honey-bear bong.

Floyd is Dick Ritchie's perma-stoned roommate who spends the whole movie on the sofa. He cheerfully gives the Mafia hitmen the location of the drug deal and later does the same for the cops, but nobody bothers to hurt him. The Beverly Ambassador shootout happens without him.

Scene-stealing cameo.
